item.title: Comment on New requirements for members seeking election to national pharmacy advisory councils by Elaine H Stone
item.description: I agree with Dr Hannay. I've been a member for over 30 years, pharmacy graduate, contributing to medicines development and have trained pre-registration students in that time. I'm disgusted that now, my society are now saying I can't apply to stand for the governing body because I'm not a GPhC member. Why? Quote:"The main reason for these changes is to make the elections as accessible and inclusive as possible to encourage and enable potential leaders from all backgrounds to consider standing."

Comment on Philip Leon Marshall Davies (1938–2026) by Steve Churton
item.description: I was very saddened to hear of Marshall’s passing. He was a true gentleman and one of the profession’s greatest advocates and contributors. Marshall had a long and impressive career with Boots. item.title: Comment on Pharmacy bodies express anger over exclusion from business rates relief by Arthur Jolley
item.description: I believe that this decision to favor Pubs and Entertainment Venues over Pharmacy premises should be challenged by as many pharmacists as possible by writing to their MPs and or the Newspapers asking why this government would rather see a local Pub kept open rather than a Local Pharmacy. Older patients need their local Pharmacy far more than their local Pub.
